name: smwmusic-touhou-youyoumu-perfect-cherry-blossom-a-sliver-of-punk-in-the-ghost-harmony-phantom-band-phantasm-ensemble-punk-mix
title: Touhou Youyoumu ~ Perfect Cherry Blossom - A Sliver of Punk in the Ghost Harmony 🎸 ~ Phantom Band ~ Phantasm Ensemble (Punk-mix)
description:
❝ No dish has ever escaped my performance alive. ❞
ㅤ- Merlin, 東方妖々夢 〜 Perfect Cherry Blossom (2005)

Did an arrangement of Phantasm Ensemble from Touhou 7 Youyoumu ~ Perfect Cherry Blossom
(ft. Get The Punk Out from Mega Man 10)
. Originally, this was just going to be a regular-ass remix of the Prismriver theme song, but then Punk's Mega Man 10 theme came to me in a dream and I knew that I was returning to mashup heaven hell.

Ironically, I'm not as much as fan of the original track (nor its Touhou 9: PFoV counterpart), but I've heard multiple arrangements of this theme that convinced me to arrange it. Besides, it's been a HOT minute since I last touched anything Touhou 7 related.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C# Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2 C# (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. B Minor (Kaeidzuka Pitch)
ㅤ4. C Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ5. D Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (Voice Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (Voice Disabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
